educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) acquire the basic ability to use IT for management.
(2) learn to program for server computers.
(3) acquire the ability to create dynamic web pages linked to a database.
advice:
In the first half of the course, students will learn to program for server computers using node.js, which is the executing environment for JavaScript. In the second half of the course, students will acquire the abilities required of a web engineer through the development of a web application combined with web pages and a database.

・For each lesson, students will need to bring a notebook PC.
・To prevent delays in completing the weekly exercises, students should consult with SA or senior SA during office hours if their program does not work.

requiredKnowledge: This course assumes that students have taken Web design, Computer Programming Basic, and Database Management. Students will need to review what they learned in these classes.

              Students will:
(1) acquire the basic ability to use IT for management.
(2) learn to program for server computers.
(3) acquire the ability to create dynamic web pages linked to a database.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

               In the first half of the course, students will learn to program for server computers using node.js, which is the executing environment for JavaScript. In the second half of the course, students will acquire the abilities required of a web engineer through the development of a web application combined with web pages and a database.

・For each lesson, students will need to bring a notebook PC.
・To prevent delays in completing the weekly exercises, students should consult with SA or senior SA during office hours if their program does not work.

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              Textbook : 教科書：Node.js超入門 第4版[秀和システム]

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              This course assumes that students have taken Web design, Computer Programming Basic, and Database Management. Students will need to review what they learned in these classes.
